senses.def: Snake Island (an island in Budjak, on the Black Sea, at the Danue Delta, Danube River in Odesa Oblast, Ukraine, on the border with Romania).
A city in Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine.
A village in Beryslav urban hromada, Beryslav Raion, Kherson Oblast, Ukraine, founded in 1804 but incorporating an older settlement (Verbivka) founded in 1782.
ex: Meronyms: Kostyrka, Mykhailivka, Verbivka (formerly separate settlements, merged into Zmiivka following the transfer of two-and-a-half thousand Boiky to the area from land ceded by the Soviet Union to Poland in 1951)

senses.def: A village in Svatove urban hromada, Svatove Raion, Luhansk Oblast, Ukraine, founded in 1954.
Former name of Kidosh: a village in Berehove urban hromada, Berehove Raion, Zakarpattia Oblast, Ukraine; used from 1946 to 1991, first mentioned in 1332.
A settlement in Vysokinsky selsoviet, Bashmakovsky Raion, Penza Oblast, Volga Federal District, Russia, founded as a khutor during the time of the Stolypin agrarian reforms (1906–1914).
An urban-type settlement and urban settlement, the administrative centre of Sverdlovsky Raion, Oryol Oblast, Central Federal District, Russia, first mentioned in 1868.

A traditional Czech knitted wool cap with no bill, topped by a small pom-pom, and encircled with a cuff into which a pattern is knitted in which smaller zig-zags are predominated by a large central zig-zag, whose angularity evokes the pattern on the back of the adder (Vipera berus), from which it takes its name.
